Sample Map pattern can be changed.
* up to 8 positions possible in one column
* need to be consecutive, no gaps
* not possible to define more Contents/Sample IDs as in the previous column
Content field needs to be defined with B, C or S
Blank, Control and Sample content cannot be combined in one column
